system.name: CodeI/O
system.one_liner: Training-data construction that turns raw code into input/output prediction tasks answered with natural-language chain-of-thought, verified by re-execution.

content.variant_note: raw code becomes reference code, input generator and query, is executed into I/O pairs, then into two colour-coded prediction questions with chain-of-thought answers and a grey dashed verification loop
content.argues: Diverse raw code can be turned into verified input-output prediction data with natural-language reasoning chains, with an optional revision round to improve the chains.
content.subject: Data-construction pipeline from raw code files to chain-of-thought input/output prediction samples, with a re-execution check.

new_tags.name: parallel-coloured-line-bundle
new_tags.what: several parallel orthogonal connectors of two hues run from different sources into one prompt block, one hue per task

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each of two paired tasks one hue and keep it on the data half, the connector bundle, the keyword of the question, the block arrow and the answer box, so that many crossing lines stay traceable; push verification and optional revision into a grey dashed loop around the edge.
lessons.suits: LLM data-synthesis pipelines where one source yields two paired training tasks and an execution or verification loop should not disturb the main path.

evidence: Raw code files are gathered from various sources and converted into a unified format.
natural language CoTs for predictions are collected from DeepSeek-V2.5
The verified CoTs can undergo optional revisions to further enhance reasoning chains.

summary: CodeI/O builds LLM training data from raw code. The figure follows the data from left to right: logos of code sources feed a DeepSeek whale that rewrites each file as reference code, an input generator and a query; sampled inputs are executed to give I/O pairs, which fill two questions, What is the input? and What is the output?, answered by a second LLM with natural-language chains of thought. Two hues, blue for input prediction and purple for output prediction, are carried through lines, arrows and answer boxes. Grey dashed loops along the top show verification by re-execution and an optional revision round. It is a flat PowerPoint drawing with pills and three stock logos.
summary_zh: CodeI/O 的数据构造流程图：原始代码经 DeepSeek 转成参考代码、输入生成器和查询，执行后得到输入输出对，再由 LLM 写出思维链来预测输入或输出。蓝色和紫色分别对应输入预测与输出预测，灰色虚线回路表示重新执行验证和可选修订。
notes: Prior label stage-pipeline / data-construction kept. The teal third source logo is not identified. The dashed Revision arrow starts at the Reference Code box and points at the input question; the figure does not label what is fed back.
